source.description: Automatisch umgewandelt aus der MusicXML-Datei „Hammerschmidt_DasWort.mxl“ der CPDL-Seite „Das Wort ward Fleisch (Andreas Hammerschmidt)“ mit tools/liedquellen/cpdl_import.py. Nicht gegen die Vorlage geprüft. Hinweis der Ausgabe: Key signature consistently set to alla breve (Most part books have a common time time signature while the C1 and A partbooks have alla breve), original note values, Musica Ficta clearly marked, original text spelling, slurs are used in C1 and A but were probably added later. They are omitted in this edition.
